content: Nguɗuk weɗ ini teeɓoh ambtiɗohiŋ Kooh na Ibrahiima
Wa Ibram raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis na yasna-nikiis (99), wa raakka mbeh, Nikiɗi teeɓukka ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne : « E mi Koohi Min, pesa findi ŋ waaɗoh, fu nik yurhiɗ.
Ŋ hey ambtiɗohe na ɗa te ŋ hey ɗa tume ɓasil. »
Wa a kerah woo keem, Ibram ƴekka po pukiŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi, Kooh taalndiɗta woyeeɗa na ɗe,
a woosa ɗe ne : « Ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗa, wa na hee tufkohe an : Fu hey nike baabiŋ ɓi cuuɓi cuuɓ,
te fu teekissuuɗi Ibram (baab yakɗuuɗ) waaye Ibrahiima (baabiŋ ɓi laayiɗ), laam ŋ hey ɗa tume caaciŋ ɓi cuuɓ laayiɗ.
Ŋ hey ɗa tume ɓasil, ɓi cuuɓi cuuɓ hey pulohe nga ɗa, ɓi buur sah hey rimkohe nga ɗa.
Ŋ hey ambtiɗohe na ɗa, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa, gomal nu nik, wa hey nike po faw. Ŋ ineem ŋ hey nike Koohiŋ ɗa na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa.
Te kur ki fu nikoh jaambur wii, wa nikka Kanaan, ŋ hey ɗa wa one jen, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa, ɗu raakoota po faw ; te ñam na hee nike Koohiŋ ɓa. »
Ŋ finho ineem, Kooh woyissa Ibrahiima ne : « E fu na hee taambkohe ɓakiŋ ɗa ŋ ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗa, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa, gomal nu nik.
Taambkohohaat ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗu, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa, an : Ƴaar nu nik nga ɗu ɗah, joyiɗ nguɗuk,
nguɗkeem weɗi na hee teeɓohe ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗu.
Komaaki ƴaar nu raak neeh yasna-kaahay ɗah, a joyiɗ nguɗuk ; na, gomal nu a min ɓaahoh ɗah, yi rimohu ŋ kahan fu po yi romohu ŋ jaambra ɓaahɗi ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗa.
Ɓa jen ɓa joyiɗ nguɗuk, a nik ñaami rimkoh ŋ kahan fu mbaa yi fu rom na koporiŋ ɗa. Te nguɗki na hee nike ŋ faan ciŋ ɗu, weɗ ini na hee teeɓohe ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗu po faw.
Ƴaar nu nguɗukɗi, te nik ne a sang sang ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗe laam raakan ɗe nguɗiɗ ambtiɗohi ŋ tufkiɗ. »
Ŋ ineem Kooh woosa Ibrahiima ne : « Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓitiifu, a teekissuuɗi Saraay ; waaye tiikiŋ ɗe wa Saarata
kotii.
Ŋ hey ɗe barke'ɗe, ŋ on ɗa kuɓu ƴaar na ɗe, ŋ hey ɗe barke'ɗe, po a nikan caaciŋ ɓi cuuɓi cuuɓ ; ɓi buur sah hey pulohe nga ɗe. »

Ibrahiima ƴekissa po pukaŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi ; a ƴennda, a woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne : « Moo ƴaar na kiis teemet (100) minisiɗ raak kuɓu e ? Te Saarata yii, na kiis ciŋ ɗe ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis (90) cii, hey raake kuɓu e ? »
A woosa ne : « A' ! Te fu amb ŋ Ismaayla rek ! »
Kooh woosa ɗe ne : « Ŋ woo ne hee, Saarata hey raake kuɓu ƴaar yi fu na hee teeke Isaahha
, ŋ hey ambtiɗohe na ɗe po faw, a yi na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗe.
Ini kaɗ ŋ Ismaayla, ŋ kerhiɗ woo kiŋ ɗa, ŋ hey ɗe barke'ɗe, ŋ tum ɗe ɓasil, e kilifa ndaŋkiyaah na kanak (12) puloh nga ɗe te a fer cuuɓ angiɗ.
Waaye ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗa nak, ŋ hey wa tufkiɗe na Isaahha, kuɓki Saarata na hee raake maas. »
Wa Kooh ƴut woo na Ibrahiima, a faɗta ɗe ndaam, a cootta ŋ ɗafka.
Weɗi Ibrahiima ɓayoh kuɓkiŋ ɗe Ismaayla na ƴaaɓa rimohu kahna na ɓa a romoot na koporaŋ ɗe, ƴaar ca nikee ŋ kahan ce jen, a nguɗta ɓa ŋ noha mbaɗi ; findi Kooh woyoh ɗe wa.
Wa Ibrahiima na nguɗke raak ɗe raakiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis na yasna-nikiis (99).
Kuɓkiŋ ɗe Ismaayla nameen raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kaahay (13) wa a na nguɗke.
Ŋ noha mbaɗi, Ibrahiima na kuɓkiŋ ɗe Ismaayla nguɗukka.
Ƴaar caŋ kahan ce jen nammba nguɗuk na ɗe mbaɗi, ɓa rimohu nga, na ɓa a rome.

footnotes.text: Tiik cii, "Saraay" na "Saarata" caɗ ɓaah tokis. Ca tokis "kuɓki ɓitɓiŋ buuri".
